newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil basket price falls as supply rises.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil basket price falls as supply rises.

text.p: Venezuela's basket price of crude oil and oil products fell 18 cents last week to stand at $16.05 per barrel on Friday, the Ministry of Energy and Mines said in a weekly statement.

Oil traders in New York attributed the dip in world prices to the end of the season of refinery maintenance closures and an associated increase in refined oil products on the market. There were also concerns over the strength of gasoline demand in the United States this summer, traditionally the peak demand season.
The Ministry statement said Venezuela's average price for April was $15.85 per barrel, against a March average of $16.85.
For the year so far, the average stood at $17.88 per barrel, down from last week's $18.15.

The Venezuelan government based its 1997 budget on an average price for the year of $14.00 per barrel, although Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta has said he expects it to average higher than $15.50.
The basket closed 1996 with one of the highest average prices for several years at $18.39 per barrel, against $14.84 for 1995.
